Crosshair_Config_Visible_Desc: Master switch. Draws a custom crosshair in the centre of the screen (fullscreen, topmost, click-through so it never blocks your mouse). Also toggleable from the Lertaro action menu.
Crosshair_Config_Code_Desc: Paste an okiaimx / VALORANT code (e.g. 0;P;c;5;o;1;0t;1;0l;2). Saving parses and applies it, overriding the individual fields below. Left empty or unchanged it leaves them alone.
Crosshair_Config_Color_Desc: 0 white / 1 green / 2 yellow-green / 3 green-yellow / 4 yellow / 5 cyan / 6 pink / 7 red / 8 custom (uses the custom colour below).
Crosshair_Config_HexColor_Desc: Hex colour such as #00FF88. Only used when the colour index is 8 (or custom colour is enabled in the editor).
Crosshair_Config_HexColorEnabled_Desc: Whether the custom colour is used (the b field of a VALORANT code). Overrides the colour index above when on.
Crosshair_Config_OutlineEnabled_Desc: Adds a black rim so the crosshair stays visible on bright and dark backgrounds (VALORANT's outlines). Keep it on.
Crosshair_Config_DotEnabled_Desc: Whether to draw the centre dot; default off.
Crosshair_Config_InnerEnabled_Desc: Whether to draw the inner lines (the four short ones closest to the centre); default on.
Crosshair_Config_InnerOffset_Desc: Distance of the lines from the centre, 0-20, default 3.
Crosshair_Config_InnerVerticalEnabled_De: Set the top/bottom lines to a different length than the left/right ones.
Crosshair_Config_InnerVerticalLength_Des: 0-20, default 6. Only used when separate vertical is on.
Crosshair_Config_OuterEnabled_Desc: Whether to draw the outer lines (the four short ones further out); default on.
Crosshair_Config_OuterOffset_Desc: Distance of the lines from the centre, 0-40, default 10.
Crosshair_Config_OuterVerticalEnabled_De: Set the top/bottom lines to a different length than the left/right ones.
Crosshair_Config_OuterVerticalLength_Des: 0-20, default 2. Only used when separate vertical is on.
Crosshair_Config_OffsetX_Desc: Plugin extra: horizontal offset from the screen centre; negative moves left, positive moves right.
Crosshair_Config_OffsetY_Desc: Plugin extra: vertical offset from the screen centre; negative moves up, positive moves down.
Crosshair_Config_Opacity_Desc: Plugin extra: an extra overall opacity on top of the okiaimx parameters, 10-100.
Crosshair_Config_Keywords_Desc: Type these in Lertaro to check the crosshair status, e.g. cross.
Crosshair_Config_Hotkey_Desc: Toggle the crosshair in-game, default Ctrl+Alt+C. Format: modifier+key (e.g. Ctrl+Alt+C, F8); leave empty to disable. Applies immediately after saving.
